description: Replace file-copy spec sync with agent-driven intelligent delta merge into openspec/specs/

tasks.title: Create spec-sync agent prompt template
tasks.description: Create the spec-sync.prompt builtin file that instructs the agent to read change delta specs from openspec/changes/issue-{number}/specs/, read existing main specs from openspec/specs/, parse ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED/RENAMED sections, intelligently merge deltas with classification correction, validate results, write merged specs to openspec/specs/, and report merge outcomes as structured output.
acceptanceCriteria: spec-sync.prompt exists at packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Workflow/Services/Prompts/builtins/spec-sync.prompt
Prompt follows the standard YAML frontmatter format with name, description, tags, and stage fields
Prompt includes the standard mo issue show header used by all execution prompts
Prompt instructs the agent to read delta specs from the change folder and main specs from openspec/specs/
Prompt instructs the agent to parse ADDED, MODIFIED, REMOVED, and RENAMED sections with explicit operation rules
Prompt instructs the agent to reclassify MODIFIED as ADDED when no matching source requirement exists (classification correction)
Prompt instructs the agent to fail on ambiguous/destructive deltas (REMOVED with unknown source, RENAMED FROM with unknown source)
Prompt instructs the agent to validate merged output before writing (no duplicate headers, every requirement has scenarios, no residual delta headers)
Prompt instructs the agent to write merged specs to openspec/specs/{capability}/spec.md (not workspace/specs/)
Prompt instructs the agent to report merge results as structured transient output (added, modified, removed, renamed by capability, plus corrections)
FilePromptLoader.LoadAll() successfully loads spec-sync as a prompt key
DefaultPrompts_LoadIssueDetailsThroughMohistCli test passes with the new prompt included
tasks.notes: Follow the exact same format as proposal.prompt, specs.prompt, etc. Use YAML frontmatter with stage: integrate. The prompt artifact schema should use artifact id="spec-sync". The agent operates on the workspace filesystem directly — no special tooling needed.

tasks.title: Wire agent-driven spec sync into integrate stage and update tests
tasks.description: Update mohist-default.workflow.yaml to change integrate:spec-sync from mohist/openspec-sync to mohist/acp-agent with the new spec-sync prompt. Update test fixtures and assertions to reflect the new agent-driven approach. Verify existing spec-sync failure semantics (archive and merge blocked on failure) are preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: integrate:spec-sync in mohist-default.workflow.yaml uses mohist/acp-agent with prompt: ${{ prompts.spec-sync }}
Task id (integrate:spec-sync) and title (Sync specs) remain unchanged
Task uses session: integrate and agent: ${{ vars.agent }}
Task ordering (spec-sync → archive-change → merge → health) is preserved
WorkflowProjectionSpecs CreateRunWithTaskRequiredFiles fixture updated: sync task uses mohist/acp-agent with UserFacing classification
All existing C# workflow profile and projection specs pass
All existing TypeScript runner tests pass
mohist/openspec-sync action handler remains registered in the action registry (no breaking removal)
tasks.output: Updated mohist-default.workflow.yaml integrate:spec-sync task definition and passing test suite
tasks.notes: Only change the uses and with fields of integrate:spec-sync. Do not change task id, title, stage ordering, or other tasks.
